prompt: During which years was Otto Schlüter a professor of geography at the University of Halle?
answer: Otto Schlüter was associated with the University of Halle as a geography professor from **1911 to 1951**. He was first professor until his emeritus status in **1938**, then returned to serve in an acting professorship, ultimately retiring again in **1951**.
